steal.note: Browser, mail, and wallet collection plus a headless Chrome launch. The sample then deletes itself.

bundle.note: Stolen sessions enrich the bundle. The lookup sites are third-party services.

rank.note: A non-browser process posts the bundle to the public OpenRouter API and falls through three models.

deliver.note: The appraisal is written to local reports and zips. Talos names Telegram as the customer channel and no operator server.
